style_prompt: Late-night synthwave pop at 92 BPM with warm analog polysynth pads, tight electronic drums, a steady sidechain pulse, clean melodic female lead vocal, restrained reverb, and a hopeful chorus lift after intimate verses. Do not mention named recording artists; keep the mix glossy but not overcompressed.
lyrics:
Verse 1
Streetlights shiver in the rain
Your message glows and fades again
I count the turns we never took
Like folded maps inside a book

Chorus
Neon rain, carry me home
Through every wire, every tone
If we get lost before the dawn
Leave one light on, leave one light on

Verse 2
The city hums beneath the glass
I let the empty taxis pass
A silver sky, a blue mistake
A little more than hearts can take

Chorus
Neon rain, carry me home
Through every wire, every tone
If we get lost before the dawn
Leave one light on, leave one light on

Bridge
No ghost, no blame, no final scene
Just all the roads we walked between

Final Chorus
Neon rain, carry me home
Through every wire, every tone
If we get lost before the dawn
Leave one light on, leave one light on
